overview.summary: The canary_dist extension provides a distributed resource-pool adapter that checks out resources from a remote server and translates them into Canary's topology-aware allocation model.

capabilities: Filter eligible machines by tags and groups.
Translate server machines into Canary ResourcePool nodes.
Check out resources from the server.
Check in resources by transaction ID.
Report maximum eligible per-machine capacity by resource type.

metadata.hostname: Remote host selected by the server.

allocation.resources: Returned resources include Canary node identity.

limitations: The distributed server adapter does not support multi-node requests.
Local accommodates checks are approximations based on cached eligible resource counts.
